test_name: System and Communications Protection - SC-7 Fully Implemented
architecture:
System: Secure-Analytics-177
Primary NIST family: System and Communications Protection (SC); evidence focus: SC-7.
Environment: AWS Commercial. Network access uses VPC interface endpoints; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a KMS CMK. Control evidence: data in transit uses TLS 1.3 and service-to-service communications use strict mutual TLS. No exceptions, overdue findings, plaintext channels, public databases, or privileged-authentication gaps are reported.
